headline: Keychron’s wireless Hall effect keyboard is back to its lowest price
summary: Get the Keychron K2 HE wireless Hall effect keyboard for just $103.99. This aluminum 75-percent layout keyboard matches its lowest-ever price. Customizable Hall effect sensors offer premium features at an affordable cost.

headline: Bose CEO Lila Snyder on the fight for high-quality audio
summary: Bose CEO Lila Snyder discusses the company's 60-year legacy in audio. Snyder highlights Bose's focus on R&D and leadership in consumer tech. The discussion covers the ongoing pursuit of high-quality audio.

headline: Boeing is selling its air taxi startups to Archer Aviation
summary: Boeing is divesting three eVTOL subsidiaries to Archer Aviation. Archer will acquire Wisk Aero and SkyGrid, focusing on autonomous flight and air traffic management. Boeing is also taking an undisclosed stake in Archer Aviation.

headline: Steam hardware shipper breach leaks customer data, including names and addresses
summary: Valve's European shipping partner, CEVA Logistics, suffered a data breach. Customer names, addresses, phone numbers, and emails for Steam hardware orders may be exposed. Valve is notifying affected users about the security incident.

headline: 'Expect Fake Messages': Valve Admits Steam Hardware Owners' Personal Data Likely Stolen
summary: Valve confirmed a data breach affecting Steam hardware customers. Personal data, including names and addresses, may have been stolen. Users are warned to expect potential fake messages after the breach.

summary: Grab an ultra-slim RFID-blocking wallet for only $3.49 on Amazon. Stack an on-page coupon with a secret promo code for this deep discount. Protect your cards and save big on this minimalist accessory.

headline: Bethesda Veteran Reveals How He Would Have Designed Starfield Differently
summary: A former Bethesda developer shared his unique vision for Starfield's design. The veteran, who worked on Skyrim and Fallout, proposed significant changes. His hypothetical Starfield concept sounds very different from the released game.

headline: Penguin's Amazing Spider-Man Classic Collection Is on Sale
summary: Penguin's Amazing Spider-Man Classic Collection is currently on sale at Amazon. Get 12 iconic 1960s stories by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko. Relive classic Spider-Man adventures for under $25.

headline: Record 230 people cross Channel in one small boat
summary: A single small boat carried a record 230 people across the Channel. The Home Office condemned the "reckless tactics" of gangs. This incident highlights the dangerous and unseaworthy nature of such crossings.

headline: Travelodge staff gave domestic abuser key to his victim's room
summary: A woman's attacker was given her room key by Travelodge staff. Her hotel room door was reportedly kicked off its hinges. The incident raises serious concerns about hotel security and guest safety protocols.

headline: Consortium including Jeff Bezos advances talks for stake in Liverpool FC
summary: A group including Amazon founder Jeff Bezos is nearing a deal for Liverpool FC. The consortium is in advanced talks to acquire about a 30% stake. BBC Sport reports on the potential high-profile investment in the football club.

headline: Ex-Cambridge professor Jason Arday cancels live event after plagiarism row
summary: Former Cambridge professor Jason Arday cancelled a live event. The cancellation follows a recent plagiarism controversy. Other talks by Arday have also been removed from listings.
